ValidationRule.description: The points sign must match the entry type.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The points sign must match the entry type.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(AND(OR(ISPICKVAL(Entry_Type__c, "PurchaseBase"), ISPICKVAL(Entry_Type__c, "CampaignBonus")), Points__c < 0), AND(OR(ISPICKVAL(Entry_Type__c, "ProfileBonus"), ISPICKVAL(Entry_Type__c, "MarketingBonus"), ISPICKVAL(Entry_Type__c, "Refund")), Points__c <= 0), AND(ISPICKVAL(Entry_Type__c, "Redemption"), Points__c >= 0), AND(ISPICKVAL(Entry_Type__c, "Adjustment"), Points__c = 0))
